name: conditional_questionnaire
description: Conditional questionnaires in notes: a note header button opens a form beside the note where a provider fills in any Questionnaire Builder questionnaire with its Field Rules applied live, the same way the builder's Preview tab shows them. Saving adds a committed Questionnaire command to the note with only the answers to questions that show. For practices whose questionnaires use Field Rules to branch.

handlers.description: Note header button, shown only on notes that can still be edited, that opens the conditional questionnaire form in the right chart pane.
When a note is locked, signed or reopened, reloads its header buttons so the Conditional Questionnaire button hides or shows without a page reload.
Serves the form, the questionnaires with their Field Rules, and the save endpoint that adds the Questionnaire command to the note.
